notablePrerequisites: You control at least six mana-producing lands, two of which can produce at least {U}.
description:
Activate six lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Dictate of Karametra triggers six times, adding {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Palinchron by paying {5}{U}{U}.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands you control.
Activate Palinchron by paying {2}{U}{U}, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
